_comment: Cases Vitro draws wrong today, each with the PR that owns its fix (#799: filed on the exp/vitro list, no fixer yet) and what's wrong. Not drift: the harness reports them as open and fails once one matches, so the fix drops its entry (ParityOpen in ParityReport.kt).

mirror/d-masonry-home.reason: Masonry dashboard: the 10 cards pair up with HA's (the capture counts a stack as one card), and their places, heights and texts match. The weather card is what's left: its current temperature's unit is drawn at the value's 24 px where HA's is a 16 px superscript (the font check), and its forecast fits five days where HA's clips the fifth, so the day columns sit up to 40 px off (the region check)

mirror/d-sections-home.reason: Sections dashboard: placement matches; the tile icon colors (battery, unavailable), the Plugs header toggle and the media art (see m-media-control-*) differ, each on its own card

mirror/entities-secondary-info.reason: Entities rows: an active automation's icon is drawn in Vitro's blue active color where HA's state-badge uses --state-active-color (amber); predates the batch (ThemeResolver.activeColor), found by the region check on #926's new case

mirror/more-info-alarm-disarmed.reason: Alarm More Info on the Mirror's tall sheet: HA centers the modes select in the sheet's height (`.controls` is flex: 1); Vitro puts it right under the state header, as for the vacuum's (s1 and tablet match)
